title: List of LGBTQ-related films of 2009

text.lead: This is a list of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender or queer -related films released in 2009. It contains theatrically released films that deal with important gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender or queer characters or issues and may have same-sex romance or relationships as a plot device.
